stops.name: Kapuziner Island
stops.quote: Prehistoric pile dwellings and artefacts dating from the 4th millennium BC have been discovered in the area around Kapuziner Island.
stops.english: Prehistoric pile dwellings and artefacts dating from the 4th millennium BC have been discovered in the area around Kapuziner Island.

stops.name: Pyramidenkogel observation tower
stops.quote: Around the lake, promenades lead to cafés, lakeside terraces and bathing spots, while attractions such as the Pyramidenkogel observation tower, Minimundus and cruises on Lake Wörthersee can easily be combined with a day by the water.
stops.english: Around the lake, promenades lead to cafés, lakeside terraces and bathing spots, while attractions such as the Pyramidenkogel observation tower, Minimundus and cruises on Lake Wörthersee can easily be combined with a day by the water.

stops.name: Maria Wörth
stops.quote: The church island of Maria Wörth is one of the most famous spots on Lake Wörthersee – with lake views, a wedding chapel and peaceful paths along the peninsula.
stops.english: The church island of Maria Wörth is one of the most famous spots on Lake Wörthersee – with lake views, a wedding chapel and peaceful paths along the peninsula.

stops.name: Pörtschach am Wörthersee
stops.quote: With 2 km of lakeside promenade, magnificent villas and historic charm, Pörtschach am Wörthersee is characterised by its lakeside setting and spa architecture.
stops.english: With 2 km of lakeside promenade, magnificent villas and historic charm, Pörtschach am Wörthersee is characterised by its lakeside setting and spa architecture.

stops.name: Klagenfurt lido
stops.quote: Despite its peaceful setting, the nature reserve is only a few minutes from Europapark, Klagenfurt lido and the city centre.
stops.english: Despite its peaceful setting, the nature reserve is only a few minutes from Europapark, Klagenfurt lido and the city centre.

stops.name: Lendspitz-Maiernigg Natura 2000 site
stops.quote: Located on the eastern bay of Lake Wörthersee, the Lendspitz-Maiernigg Natura 2000 site is a protected habitat for numerous animal and plant species and one of Klagenfurt's most valuable natural areas.
stops.english: Located on the eastern bay of Lake Wörthersee, the Lendspitz-Maiernigg Natura 2000 site is a protected habitat for numerous animal and plant species and one of Klagenfurt's most valuable natural areas.

stops.name: Velden
stops.quote: Boutique hotels, lakeside terraces, and bars are a defining feature of Velden's townscape – particularly during the summer months along the lakeside promenade.
stops.english: Boutique hotels, lakeside terraces, and bars are a defining feature of Velden's townscape – particularly during the summer months along the lakeside promenade.

stops.name: Restaurant Maria Loretto
stops.quote: In Klagenfurt, Restaurant Maria Loretto enjoys a unique location on a peninsula, with a spacious terrace overlooking the lake.
stops.english: In Klagenfurt, Restaurant Maria Loretto enjoys a unique location on a peninsula, with a spacious terrace overlooking the lake.

stops.name: Promenadenbad Pörtschach
stops.quote: Numerous lidos line the shores of Lake Wörthersee, including Klagenfurt Lido , Promenadenbad Pörtschach and Velden Lido .
